mapper.delete: delete from problem_tag pt where pt.problem_id = #{problemId} and pt.tag_id = #{tagId}
mapper.select: select tag_name from problem_tag pt left join tag t on pt.tag_id = t.id where pt.problem_id = #{problemId} order by pt.tag_id asc
